entries.title: Leviticus 22:2
segments: Separate themselves from the holy things; abstain from partaking of them when they were ceremonially unclean, and could not partake without defiling them.

entries.title: Leviticus 22:3
segments:
Hallow; consecrate. 
 
Known and allowed iniquity, secret or open, unfits a man for the acceptable discharge of sacred duties; and without repentance and reformation he will be excluded from the holy society and worship of heaven.

entries.title: Leviticus 22:7
segments: Eat of the holy things; that part of them which belonged to the priests.

entries.title: Leviticus 22:9
segments: Neglect of the ordinances of God, or a profane attendance on them, exposes men to punishment for their iniquity.

entries.title: Leviticus 22:11
segments: He shall eat of it; because he belonged to the family, and was entitled to its privileges.

entries.title: Leviticus 22:13
segments: Those who minister in holy things have a right to support, not only for themselves, but for their families.

entries.title: Leviticus 22:14
segments:
Unwittingly; not knowing that it was holy, or consecrated to God. 
 
  The fifth--give it unto the priest; he should pay for what he ate and one fifth part more.  This was designed to make them careful not to offend ignorantly.

entries.title: Leviticus 22:16
segments:
Or suffer them to bear the iniquity; more literally, lade them with the iniquity of trespass, namely, by eating of their offerings in an unlawful way.  For the priests acted in behalf of the people, and their sins would bring God's displeasure upon the congregation of Israel. 
 
Ministers of religion should labor to enlighten the people as to the will of God, that they may not sin ignorantly; and if they have so sinned, should use all suitable means to reclaim them, and bring them in future to know and obey the truth.

entries.title: Leviticus 22:19
segments: At your own will; rather, for your acceptance; and so
. The expressions, for acceptance, for your acceptance, it shall be accepted, etc., are often added to signify that the offerer is to comply with the rules of the Levitical law.  So in

entries.title: Leviticus 22:21
segments: God justly requires that which is perfect; and the best that we offer can be accepted only through the atonement, righteousness, and intercession of Christ.

entries.title: Leviticus 22:27
segments: Under the dam; with its mother.

entries.title: Leviticus 22:31
segments: Notwithstanding all that Christ has done, no one is or can be saved by him, unless as he is made willing heartily to obey God's commands.

entries.title: Leviticus 22:32
segments:
Profane my holy name; by disregarding his directions. 
 
  Hallowed; reverenced, honored, obeyed.
